name: Forgiving Your Enemies
overview: Scripture calls believers to a radical love that extends even to their enemies, overturning the common notion that hatred toward foes is acceptable, as Jesus teaches in Matthew 5:43-44. Forgiveness is not optional but essential, for God promises to forgive those who forgive others (Matthew 6:14). Wisdom and discretion guide believers to control anger and overlook offenses, bringing glory in doing so (Proverbs 19:11). The process of restoring relationships through confrontation and repeated forgiveness is also emphasized, showing the importance of continual grace within the community of faith (Matthew 18:15, 21).
